title: Thyroid Function and Structure in Klinefelter Syndrome
official: Thyroid Function and Structure in Klinefelter Syndrome (THINKS)
summary: This is a longitudinal retrospective study for the evaluation of thyroid function and structure in patients with Klinefelter syndrome compared to healthy controls and patients affected by chronic lymphocytic thyroiditis.
central: Andrea M Isidori, MD, PhD · 0039649970711 · andrea.isidori@uniroma1.it
